subject: Evaluation credits & trial extension for HCMSoft RFP
messages:
From: Ana Torres <ana.torres@hcmsoft.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jeff Lee <jeff.lee@hcmsoft.com>, Procurement <procurement@hcmsoft.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: extra evaluation credits & short trial extension for RFP bake-off

Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're running a tight internal bake-off next week across three vendors and need a small extension and a bump in credits in order to finish our benchmark runs and include Redwood's outputs in our scoring.

Current ask: +$1,000 worth of eval credits (approx. 500k tokens) and a 7-day trial extension (from 8/15 -> 8/22). Procurement wants this documented for the RFP appendix.

Attached is an excerpt from the RFP schedule and the list of evaluation prompts. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide this and if there are any usage limits we should note?

Best,
Ana Torres
Lead AI Architect, HCMSoft

Attachment: HCMSoft_RFP_QA.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Torres <ana.torres@hcmsoft.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: extra evaluation credits & short trial extension for RFP bake-off

Ana — really glad HCMSoft is considering Redwood for the bake-off. We can absolutely support the runs; appreciate the detail in the attachment.

Proposed offer (pre-approval):
- $1,000 eval credit applied to your trial account (approx. 500k tokens)
- Trial extension for 7 days, ending 2026-08-22
- Limits: we’ll cap per-hour QPS to keep the environment fair for other trials — I’ll include a note in the account.

I need to get a quick sign-off from RevOps/Finance for the promotional credit. Looping in internal folks now — will confirm by EOD. If approved, I’ll send a signed credit note and DocuSign link for your procurement team.

Next step: if you could share the preferred billing/procurement contact and the DocuSign contact, I’ll include them in the dispatch.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 12:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: extra evaluation credits & short trial extension for RFP bake-off

Karthik / Vivek — forwarding Ana’s ask. Quick notes from an SE perspective:
- Fair to provide credits to enable end-to-end scoring, but limit to non-production eval usage only.
- Recommend scoped credit note: usable for 7 days only, non-transferable, and tied to HCMSoft account id.
- Suggested telemetry: create a shared workspace so we can collect logs and eval outputs in a single place for comparison. Will save time and avoid replays.

If RevOps is okay with $1k, SEs can help set up the workspace and run a quick health-check on their prompt harness.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: extra evaluation credits & short trial extension for RFP bake-off

Thanks for the context. Fine to approve a one-off promotional credit for competitive bake-offs with these guardrails:
- Credit amount capped at $1,000; must be documented with a credit note and expiration date (no rollovers).
- Trial extension limited to 7 days, account flagged as "evaluation-only" in our billing system.
- No SLA or production support implied; these are evaluation privileges.

Monica — please prepare the credit note and get legal to sign off on the standard promotional T&Cs (I don’t expect special terms here).

Vivek
VP, Growth — Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Torres <ana.torres@hcmsoft.com>, Jeff Lee <jeff.lee@hcmsoft.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@hcmsoft.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: extra evaluation credits & short trial extension for RFP bake-off

Ana / Jeff — good news: we’re approved. Summary and next steps below.

What we’re providing:
- $1,000 evaluation credit applied to HCMSoft trial account (approx. 500k tokens).
- Trial extended through 2026-08-22.
- Credit note and promo terms attached (non-transferable; evaluation-only).

Attachments: proposed_credit_note.pdf (credit note + promotional T&Cs)
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/templates/ABCD1234 — we’ll send this to your procurement contact once you confirm the correct signer.

Please confirm the signer name/email for DocuSign and the procurement billing contact. Once we have that, I’ll finalize the DocuSign envelope and apply the credit.

We’ll also provision a shared evaluation workspace and Marissa will reach out to schedule a 30-min setup call to integrate your prompt harness.

Thanks — excited to be part of the bake-off.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference
